rule: TypeScript-only: a successful stream requires response.completed. Events split on any blank line (LF, CRLF or bare CR); data: lines join the same way, even when a chunk ends mid-line-ending. The text is the concatenated response.output_text.delta deltas; the completed envelope's output_text is used only when no deltas arrived. A data line that is not JSON (other than [DONE]) throws a ResponseError that is not about the account, instead of vanishing. A stream that ends with no deltas, no completed output text and no output items throws the network 'stopped before completing' error. SSE error codes usage_not_included and rate_limit_exceeded preserve their kinds even when messages are generic. A stream may carry tool calls: response.function_call_arguments.delta deltas accumulate per output item, response.output_item.done carries each finished item, and response.completed.response.output is the authoritative item list. Items without output_text contribute no text.
